description: This file handles the saving and sending of email records within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes logic for retrieving email records, processing email fields, handling attachments, parsing templates, managing relationships, and redirecting after save.

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and managing email templates within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: merge_time_meridiem
methods.description: Merges time and meridiem (AM/PM) into a complete time string.

methods.name: parse_template
methods.description: Parses email templates by replacing variables with actual data.

methods.name: split_date_time
methods.description: Splits a datetime into separate date and time components.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current date and time.
